content:
Pre-order deals for the all-new Apple Watch Series 12 models continue today, alongside the new AirPods 5 (Active Noise Cancellation) hitting a historic low of $125, along with Amazon's early kickoff of the fall Prime Day sales. In addition, AirPods Pro 3 discounts of $50 are still going strong, and we've also spotted Amazon reopening pre-order discounts on the most affordable new M6 Mac mini as well as the 24GB variant. Also part of the mix: $150 off M5 MacBook Air, Apple's 2026 Studio Display XDR back down to its Amazon all-time low at $330 off, $80 off the Hyper 2026 Thunderbolt 5 Dock, and an exclusive discount on the Bluebonnet Saddle Tan leather iPhone 18 Pro case with copper buttons. Details below.

Amazon's early kickoff fall Prime Day deals are now live: Apple, Pixel, Anker, Grubhub $20 off, and more

Brand new AirPods 5 with Active Noise Cancellation down to $125 with Friday delivery, or AirPods Pro 3 for $199

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (orig. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (orig. $549)
  • AirPods 5 $125 (orig. $129)
  • AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case $149

Amazon's most affordable M6 Mac mini pre-order discount is back

Apple's most affordable new M6 Mac mini officially goes on sale next week, and Amazon just reopened pre-order discounts.

This morning we saw Amazon reopen pre-order deals on the higher-end 24GB model, and those looking to score the most affordable new M6 mini can now also enjoy the early pre-order savings once again.

Amazon is once again selling the 2026 Apple M6 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 256GB storage for $879.99 with free shipping.

This price has been bouncing around lately and may come and go before the on-sale date next week.

While it's not a huge discount, this is the only way to save some cash before delivery next week — $20 in your pocket is better than nothing, and Amazon's deal matches Apple's official pricing exactly.

Here's a roundup of the pre-order discounts across the new M6, M5 Max, and Mac Studio models:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (orig. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (orig. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (orig. $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (orig. $1,699)
  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (orig. $2,499)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (orig. $1,799)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (orig. $1,599)

Apple 2026 Studio Display XDR back down to Amazon all-time low at $330 off

Deals on Apple's latest 2026 Studio Display lineup have been going in and out all month, but we have another shot at scoring the Apple Studio Display XDR with the tilt- and height-adjustable stand at the lowest price we've ever tracked — $330 off.

Amazon is now selling the latest Apple Studio Display XDR with standard glass and the tilt- and height-adjustable stand for $2,969 with free shipping.

This higher-end XDR display with the gorgeous tilt- and height-adjustable stand carries a $3,299 list price and is now $330 off, matching the lowest price we've tracked.

We've seen this same deal pop up a few times on Amazon this month, but it never dipped below $3,150 before with this particular configuration.

Apple launched the upgraded all-new Studio Display this spring, and it's just as gorgeous as the previous generation. The price of entry is certainly steep, but in my book it's the most beautiful display to pair with your new M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio.

More Apple Watch Series 12 models now up for early pre-order deals at Amazon

The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 is set to deliver within 48 hours, and just like the AirPods 5 deal at $125, several configurations are now available with early pre-order savings at Amazon. These small discounts have been trickling in at Amazon since the start of this week, and now more case colors, sizes, and band styles have joined the fray — we've rounded them all up for you.

Of course, these aren't huge price drops, but ahead of the Series 12 launch, they're the best cash discounts around. If you're still hoping to pre-order this week and get yours as soon as possible, Amazon has the lowest prices and nearly every model is still shipping by Friday (as of writing):

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm: $490 (orig. $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm: $679 (orig. $699)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Milanese: $729 (orig. $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $440 (orig. $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $540 (orig. $549)

Hyper 2026 Thunderbolt 5 Dock back down to Amazon low at $80 off: SSD enclosure, triple-display support, and more

Not all docking stations are created equal, and in my experience, it's usually a product worth spending a bit more on, especially for Mac users looking to set up multi-display configurations. This year's HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with built-in SSD enclosure is a solid, well-built choice that works just as well for a pro-level setup as it does for your desktop workstation — and it's now back down to its lowest price ever at $80 off.

Hyper's official Amazon storefront is once again selling the 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure for $319.99 with free shipping.

That's $80 off the $400 list price, matching the all-time low we've tracked on Amazon. We've seen this same discount on and off over the past few months, and now it's back — matching the price we tracked during this June's Prime Day.

That said, this is still an investment-grade piece of gear, but for those wanting a truly heavy-duty docking station, it might just be worth it. The solid metal build supports triple-display output for Windows PCs and MacBook Pro M5 Pro/Max (2026):

Built-in M.2 PCIe Gen 4 x4 and Gen 3 slots for additional storage expansion, 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 speeds, and the following connectivity options:

  • 2x Thunderbolt 5 downstream ports
  • 3x USB-A (10Gbps)
  • RJ-45 2.5Gbps Ethernet
  • 3.5mm audio jack
  • Nano and standard Kensington lock slots
  • 140W power pass-through
  • DC 20V power supply

Bluebonnet Saddle Tan leather iPhone 18 Pro case with copper buttons: 20% off for 9to5 readers
